stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id","body_start","body_end","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","function","decorator" FROM (SELECT f.*,c.id decorator FROM eligible_declarations f JOIN decorator_names d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.callee_id=d.node AND c.parent=d.decorator WHERE (d.name='cached_pure_lazy' OR c.callee_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cached_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee)) GROUP BY f.__path,f.id)

stages.name: pseudo_cached
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","function","error" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id,m.module||'.<unsupported_cached_pure_lazy_call_'||(c.line+1)||'_'||length(rx_extract(source_text(c.__path,0,c.__start),'[^\n]*$',0))||'>' function,CASE WHEN c.callee='cached_pure_lazy' OR c.callee_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cached_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee) THEN 'cached_pure_lazy must use decorator syntax' ELSE 'unresolved cache decorator alias is forbidden' END error FROM calls c JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=c.__path WHERE c.callee!='CachedPureLazyPolicyEntry' AND (c.callee='cached_pure_lazy' OR c.callee_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cached_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='cache_args')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d WHERE d.__path=c.__path AND d.node=c.callee_id AND d.decorator=c.parent AND (d.name='cached_pure_lazy' OR c.callee_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cached_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.id,m.module||'.<escaped_cached_pure_lazy_reference_'||(n.line+1)||'_'||length(rx_extract(source_text(n.__path,0,n.__start),'[^\n]*$',0))||'>','cached_pure_lazy cannot escape as a first-class value' FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE (n.kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cached_aliases a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.name=n.text) OR n.kind='attribute' AND n.attribute_source='cached_pure_lazy') AND par.kind NOT IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import','import_from_statement','import_statement') AND NOT(n.kind='identifier' AND par.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','attribute','keyword_argument','typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter','default_parameter','parameters') AND (par.kind='parameters' OR n.id=par.name_id OR par.kind='attribute' AND n.id=par.attribute_id)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.callee_id=n.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND (a.value=n.id OR a.target=n.id)) AND par.kind!='delete_statement')

stages.name: actual_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","function","body_sha256","signature_sha256" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.function,h.body_sha256,h.signature_sha256 FROM selected_functions f JOIN fingerprints h ON h.__path=f.__path AND h.id=f.id UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.id,p.function,h.dump_sha256,h.dump_sha256 FROM pseudo_cached p JOIN pseudo_fingerprints h ON h.__path=p.__path AND h.id=p.id)

stages.name: cache_arguments
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","ordinal","name" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,CAST(x.ordinal AS INTEGER) ordinal,s.value name FROM selected_functions f JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator AND k.name='cache_args' JOIN nodes container ON container.__path=k.__path AND container.id=k.value AND container.kind IN ('tuple','list') JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=container.__path AND x.parent=container.id JOIN strings s ON s.__path=x.__path AND s.__start=x.__start WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.call=f.decorator) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM keywords kw WHERE kw.__path=f.__path AND kw.call=f.decorator)=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=container.__path AND n.parent=container.id AND n.kind NOT IN ('string','concatenated_string','comment')))

stages.name: cache_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "__path:1","__start","__end","id","parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_source" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,n.* FROM selected_functions f JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end JOIN cache_arguments a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND a.name=n.text LEFT JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (par.kind='attribute' AND n.id=par.attribute_id))

stages.name: cache_attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "__path:1",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end","parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end","parameters_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_source","attr","object","object_text","member","parent_kind:1","parent_id","mode" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,a.*,substr(a.text,length(root.name)+2) member,par.kind parent_kind,par.id parent_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=a.__path AND c.callee_id=a.id) THEN 'call' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c JOIN arguments arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.call=c.id WHERE c.__path=a.__path AND arg.id=a.id) THEN 'resolver' ELSE 'read' END mode FROM selected_functions f JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=a.__path AND root.expression=a.id AND NOT root.through_call JOIN cache_arguments arg ON arg.__path=f.__path AND arg.fn=f.id AND arg.name=root.name JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=a.__path AND par.id=a.parent WHERE NOT (par.kind='attribute' AND par.object_id=a.id))

stages.name: mutations
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "fn","id" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.id FROM cache_attributes a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.target=a.id) OR a.parent_kind='delete_statement')

stages.name: member_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "fn","id" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.id FROM cache_attributes a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.value=a.id))

stages.name: cache_members
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","member","mode" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.fn,rx_replace(a.member,'\s+','') member,a.mode FROM cache_attributes a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mutations x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM member_aliases x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id) AND a.member NOT IN ('__class__','__delattr__','__dict__','__getattribute__','__setattr__'))

stages.name: mutable_globals
stages.query: SELECT "__path","name" FROM (SELECT a.__path,b.name FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=a.__path AND stmt.id=a.parent JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=stmt.__path AND parent.id=stmt.parent WHERE parent.kind='module' AND a.expr_kind NOT IN ('string','concatenated_string','integer','float','true','false','none') AND NOT (a.expr_kind='tuple' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=a.__path AND n.__start>a.right_start AND n.__end<a.right_end AND n.kind IN ('identifier','call','list','dictionary','set'))) AND NOT (a.expr_kind='call' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=a.__path AND c.id=a.value AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='frozenset') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=a.__path AND k.call=a.value)))

stages.name: extra_cached_errors
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","error" FROM (SELECT arg.__path,arg.fn,'cache argument '||quote(arg.name)||' cannot have a default' error FROM cache_arguments arg JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=arg.__path AND p.fn=arg.fn AND p.name=arg.name WHERE p.kind IN ('default_parameter','typed_default_parameter') UNION ALL SELECT arg.__path,arg.fn,'cache argument '||quote(arg.name)||' must be keyword-only' FROM cache_arguments arg JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=arg.__path AND p.fn=arg.fn AND p.name=arg.name JOIN nodes param ON param.__path=p.__path AND param.id=p.id JOIN selected_functions f ON f.__path=p.__path AND f.id=p.fn WHERE arg.name!='self' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes star WHERE star.__path=f.__path AND star.parent=f.parameters_id AND star.__start<param.__start AND star.kind IN ('keyword_separator','list_splat_pattern')) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'a cache argument cannot be captured by a closure' FROM selected_functions f JOIN nodes closure ON closure.__path=f.__path AND closure.__start>=f.body_start AND closure.__end<=f.body_end AND closure.kind IN ('function_definition','lambda','generator_expression') WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cache_names n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.fn=f.id AND n.__start>=closure.__start AND n.__end<=closure.__end) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,c.callee||'() on a cache argument is forbidden' FROM selected_functions f JOIN calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('delattr','getattr','hasattr','setattr','vars') WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN cache_names n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.__start>=a.__start AND n.__end<=a.__end AND n.fn=f.id WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'cached pure-lazy functions cannot read mutable global state '||quote(g.name) FROM selected_functions f JOIN mutable_globals g ON g.__path=f.__path JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=g.name JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE par.kind NOT IN ('global_statement','nonlocal_statement') AND NOT(par.kind='attribute' AND par.attribute_id=n.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.target=n.id) UNION ALL SELECT __path,id,error FROM pseudo_cached)

stages.name: cached_errors
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","error" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,'cached pure-lazy functions must be synchronous' error FROM selected_functions f WHERE rx_matches(f.text,'^async\s') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'cached pure-lazy functions cannot use variadic arguments' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.parameters_start AND n.__end<=f.parameters_end AND n.kind IN ('list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern')) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'cached pure-lazy functions cannot be generators' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end AND n.kind='yield') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.fn,'a cache argument can only be used through signed member access' FROM cache_names n JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE NOT(par.kind='attribute' AND par.object_id=n.id) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'a cache argument cannot escape through return' FROM selected_functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.__start>=f.body_start AND r.__end<=f.body_end WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cache_names n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.fn=f.id AND n.__start>=r.__start AND n.__end<=r.__end) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,'cached pure-lazy functions cannot write mutable global state' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end AND n.kind IN ('global_statement','nonlocal_statement')) UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,'direct cache attribute mutation '||quote(a.member)||' is forbidden' FROM cache_attributes a JOIN mutations x ON x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,'cache member alias '||quote(a.member)||' is forbidden' FROM cache_attributes a JOIN member_aliases x ON x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,'cache subscript '||CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments x WHERE x.__path=n.__path AND x.target=n.id) OR par.kind='delete_statement' THEN 'mutation' ELSE 'access' END||' through '||quote(a.member)||' is forbidden' FROM cache_attributes a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.id=a.parent_id AND n.kind='subscript' JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,'dynamic cache access '||quote(a.member)||' is forbidden' FROM cache_attributes a WHERE a.member IN ('__class__','__delattr__','__dict__','__getattribute__','__setattr__') UNION ALL SELECT arg.__path,arg.fn,'cache argument '||quote(arg.name)||' requires an exact annotation' FROM cache_arguments arg WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=arg.__path AND p.fn=arg.fn AND p.name=arg.name AND p.annotation IS NOT NULL))

stages.name: policy_args
stages.query: SELECT "function","ordinal","name" FROM (SELECT p.function,x.key ordinal,x.value name FROM policy_entries p,json_each(p.data,'$.cache_args') x)

stages.name: policy_types
stages.query: SELECT "function",NULL AS "ordinal","name","type" FROM (SELECT p.function,x.key ordinal,json_extract(x.value,'$[0]') name,json_extract(x.value,'$[1]') type FROM policy_entries p,json_each(p.data,'$.cache_types') x)

stages.name: policy_members
stages.query: SELECT "function","ordinal","member","mode" FROM (SELECT p.function,x.key ordinal,json_extract(x.value,'$[0]') member,json_extract(x.value,'$[1]') mode FROM policy_entries p,json_each(p.data,'$.allowed_cache_members') x)

stages.name: member_reprs
stages.query: SELECT "function","actual","policy" FROM (SELECT f.function,coalesce((SELECT '('||group_concat(pair,', ')||CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||')' FROM (SELECT '('||quote(member)||', '||quote(mode)||')' pair FROM cache_members m WHERE m.__path=f.__path AND m.fn=f.id ORDER BY member,mode)),'()') actual,coalesce((SELECT '('||group_concat(pair,', ')||CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||')' FROM (SELECT '('||quote(member)||', '||quote(mode)||')' pair FROM policy_members m WHERE m.function=f.function ORDER BY ordinal)),'()') policy FROM actual_functions f)

stages.name: cached_comparisons
stages.query: SELECT "function","error" FROM (SELECT f.function,e.error FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function JOIN (SELECT * FROM cached_errors UNION SELECT * FROM extra_cached_errors) e ON e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id UNION SELECT f.function,'decorator cache arguments changed' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE EXISTS(SELECT ordinal,name FROM cache_arguments a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id EXCEPT SELECT ordinal,name FROM policy_args a WHERE a.function=f.function) OR EXISTS(SELECT ordinal,name FROM policy_args a WHERE a.function=f.function EXCEPT SELECT ordinal,name FROM cache_arguments a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id) UNION SELECT f.function,'cache type metadata must name each cache argument exactly once' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE EXISTS(SELECT name FROM policy_types t WHERE t.function=f.function GROUP BY name HAVING count(*)>1) OR EXISTS(SELECT name FROM policy_args a WHERE a.function=f.function EXCEPT SELECT name FROM policy_types t WHERE t.function=f.function) OR EXISTS(SELECT name FROM policy_types t WHERE t.function=f.function EXCEPT SELECT name FROM policy_args a WHERE a.function=f.function) UNION SELECT f.function,'cache type '||quote(t.type)||' is not approved' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_types t ON t.function=f.function WHERE t.type!='l2070_batching.optimizer_run_cache.OptimizerRunCache' UNION SELECT f.function,'cache argument '||quote(t.name)||' annotation '||CASE WHEN annotation.text IS NULL THEN 'None' ELSE quote(annotation.text) END||' does not match cache type '||quote(t.type) FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_types t ON t.function=f.function LEFT JOIN parameters a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND a.name=t.name LEFT JOIN nodes annotation ON annotation.__path=a.__path AND annotation.id=a.annotation WHERE annotation.text IS NOT rx_replace(t.type,'^.*\.','') UNION SELECT f.function,'owner scope '||quote(json_extract(p.data,'$.owner_scope'))||' is not approved' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE json_extract(p.data,'$.owner_scope')!='optimizer_run' UNION SELECT f.function,'review rationale is required' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE trim(p.rationale)='' UNION SELECT f.function,'cache member access modes are invalid: ['||(SELECT group_concat(quote(mode),', ') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT mode FROM policy_members m WHERE m.function=f.function AND mode NOT IN ('call','read','resolver') ORDER BY mode))||']' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_members m WHERE m.function=f.function AND mode NOT IN ('call','read','resolver')) UNION SELECT f.function,'function body hash changed' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE f.body_sha256!=p.body_hash UNION SELECT f.function,'function signature hash changed' FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function WHERE f.signature_sha256!=p.signature_hash UNION SELECT f.function,'cache member access changed: actual='||r.actual||' policy='||r.policy FROM actual_functions f JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=f.function JOIN member_reprs r ON r.function=f.function WHERE r.actual!=r.policy)

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "issue" FROM (SELECT 'unsigned cached pure-lazy function: '||f.function issue FROM actual_functions f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_entries p WHERE p.function=f.function) UNION ALL SELECT 'stale cached pure-lazy policy entry: '||p.function FROM policy_entries p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM actual_functions f WHERE f.function=p.function) UNION ALL SELECT function||': '||error FROM cached_comparisons UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate decorator entry: '||function FROM actual_functions GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate policy entry: '||function FROM policy_records GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1)

cases.policy_violations: SELECT 'l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,issue,issue identity FROM diagnostics
cases.all: SELECT 'l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,issue,issue identity FROM diagnostics

query.default: SELECT 'l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,issue,issue identity FROM diagnostics WHERE 0

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_source","attr",NULL AS "object",NULL AS "object_text" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_id AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute')

stages.name: calls

stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "module_name_source",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "module_name_id","call","position" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,n.id,n.parent,n.edge_parent,n.ordinal,n.text,n.kind,n.line,n.parent_start,n.parent_end,n.parent_kind,n.ancestor_start,n.ancestor_end,n.ancestor_kind,n.name_start,n.name_end,n.name_kind,n.name_source,n.value_start,n.value_end,n.value_kind,n.function_start,n.function_end,n.function_kind,n.arguments_start,n.arguments_end,n.arguments_kind,n.object_start,n.object_end,n.object_kind,n.object_source,n.attribute_source,n.body_start,n.body_end,n.parameters_start,n.parameters_end,n.module_name_source,n.name_id,n.value_id,n.function_id,n.arguments_id,n.object_id,n.attribute_id,n.body_id,n.parameters_id,n.module_name_id,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_id WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat'))

stages.name: keywords

stages.name: declarations
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_start","name_end","name_kind","name_source","value_id","value_start","value_end","value_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","arguments_id","arguments_start","arguments_end","arguments_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","module_name_id","module_name_source","name","region_start" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source name,coalesce(w.__start,n.__start) region_start FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes w ON w.__path=n.__path AND w.id=n.parent AND w.kind='decorated_definition' WHERE n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition'))

FROM (SELECT name FROM declarations a WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.region_start<d.region_start AND a.__end>=d.__end ORDER BY a.region_start))||'.','')||d.name qualname,
        (SELECT a.id FROM declarations a WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.region_start<d.region_start AND a.__end>=d.__end ORDER BY a.region_start DESC LIMIT 1) lexical_parent FROM declarations d)

stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","decorator","node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: module_names

stages.name: policy_entries
stages.query: SELECT NULL AS "ordinal","data","function","body_hash","signature_hash","rationale" FROM (SELECT p.* FROM policy_records p WHERE p.ordinal=(SELECT max(x.ordinal) FROM policy_records x WHERE x.function=p.function))

stages.name: eligible_declarations
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_start","name_end","name_kind","name_source","value_id","value_start","value_end","value_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","arguments_id","arguments_start","arguments_end","arguments_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","module_name_id","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","function" FROM (SELECT d.*,m.module||'.'||coalesce((SELECT group_concat(part,'.') FROM (SELECT a.name||CASE WHEN a.kind='function_definition' THEN '.<locals>' ELSE '' END part FROM declarations a WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.region_start<d.region_start AND a.__end>=d.__end ORDER BY a.region_start))||'.','')||d.name function FROM declaration_contexts d JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=d.__path WHERE d.kind='function_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes wrapper JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=wrapper.__path AND parent.id=wrapper.parent WHERE wrapper.__path=d.__path AND (wrapper.id=d.id OR wrapper.id=d.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition') AND parent.kind NOT IN ('module','block','decorated_definition')))

stages.name: selected_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id","body_start","body_end",NULL AS "parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_source",NULL AS "name",NULL AS "region_start",NULL AS "qualname",NULL AS "lexical_parent","function","decorator" FROM (SELECT f.*,c.id decorator FROM eligible_declarations f JOIN decorator_names d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.callee_id=d.node AND c.parent=d.decorator WHERE d.name='memoized_pure_lazy' AND c.callee_kind='identifier' GROUP BY f.__path,f.id)

stages.name: actual_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","function","body_sha256","signature_sha256" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.function,h.body_sha256,h.signature_sha256 FROM selected_functions f JOIN fingerprints h ON h.__path=f.__path AND h.id=f.id)

stages.name: memoized_bounds
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text","value","max_entries" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,k.kind,k.text,k.value,CASE WHEN k.kind='integer' THEN CAST(replace(k.text,'_','') AS INTEGER) END max_entries FROM selected_functions f LEFT JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator AND k.name='max_entries')

stages.name: memoized_errors
stages.query: SELECT "function","error" FROM (SELECT f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy requires the canonical pure_lazy marker' error FROM selected_functions f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name='pure_lazy' AND n.kind='identifier' AND par.kind='decorator') UNION ALL SELECT f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy requires one literal max_entries keyword' FROM selected_functions f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator)!=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator AND k.name='max_entries') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.call=f.decorator) UNION ALL SELECT f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy max_entries must be a literal integer' FROM selected_functions f JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.id=f.id WHERE b.max_entries IS NULL AND b.value IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy max_entries must be positive' FROM selected_functions f JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.id=f.id WHERE b.max_entries<1 UNION ALL SELECT function,'memoized pure-lazy functions must be synchronous' FROM selected_functions WHERE rx_matches(text,'^async\s') UNION ALL SELECT f.function,'memoized pure-lazy functions cannot use variadic arguments' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.parameters_start AND n.__end<=f.parameters_end AND n.kind IN ('list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern')) UNION ALL SELECT f.function,'memoized pure-lazy functions cannot be generators' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end AND n.kind='yield'))

stages.name: memoized_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "function","error" FROM (SELECT m.module||'.<memoized_decorator_alias_'||(n.line+1)||'>' function,'memoized_pure_lazy decorator aliases are forbidden' error FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind='import_from_statement' AND n.module_name_source='l2055_lazy_result.purity' AND a.kind='aliased_import' AND a.name_source='memoized_pure_lazy' UNION ALL SELECT m.module||'.<private_memoized_storage_access_'||(n.line+1)||'_'||(n.__start-coalesce((SELECT max(x.__start) FROM nodes x WHERE x.__path=n.__path AND x.line=n.line AND x.__start<=n.__start AND x.kind='module'),n.__start-length(rx_extract(source_text(n.__path,0,n.__start),'[^\n]*$',0))))||'>','direct access to private memoization storage is forbidden' FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path LEFT JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text IN ('_MEMOIZED_PURE_LAZY_STATE_CREATION_LOCK','_MemoizedPureLazyState','_memoized_purity_decorator') AND par.kind NOT IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import','import_from_statement') AND n.__path NOT LIKE '%l2055_lazy_result/purity.py')

stages.name: all_memoized
stages.query: SELECT "function" FROM (SELECT function FROM actual_functions UNION ALL SELECT function FROM memoized_aliases)

stages.name: memoized_comparisons
stages.query: SELECT "function","error" FROM (SELECT a.function,'memoization bound changed' error FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.id=a.id WHERE b.max_entries IS NOT json_extract(e.data,'$.max_entries') UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'cache lifetime is not approved' error FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE json_extract(e.data,'$.cache_lifetime') IS NOT 'process' UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'key policy is not approved' error FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE json_extract(e.data,'$.key_policy') IS NOT 'bound_explicit_immutable_v1' UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'return policy is not approved' error FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE json_extract(e.data,'$.return_policy') IS NOT 'immutable_no_alias_v1' UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'exception policy is not approved' error FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE json_extract(e.data,'$.exception_policy') IS NOT 'successful_results_only_v1' UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'review rationale is required' FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE trim(e.rationale)='' UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'function body hash changed' FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE a.body_sha256!=e.body_hash UNION ALL SELECT a.function,'function signature hash changed' FROM actual_functions a JOIN policy_entries e ON e.function=a.function WHERE a.signature_sha256!=e.signature_hash)

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "issue" FROM (SELECT 'unsigned memoized pure-lazy function: '||a.function issue FROM all_memoized a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_entries p WHERE p.function=a.function) UNION ALL SELECT 'stale memoized pure-lazy policy entry: '||p.function FROM policy_entries p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM all_memoized a WHERE a.function=p.function) UNION ALL SELECT function||': '||error FROM memoized_errors UNION ALL SELECT function||': '||error FROM memoized_aliases UNION ALL SELECT function||': '||error FROM memoized_comparisons UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate memoized decorator entry: '||function FROM all_memoized GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate memoized policy entry: '||function FROM policy_records GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1)

stages.name: runtime_nodes
stages.query: SELECT "label","name","__path","id" FROM (SELECT p.label,p.name,n.__path,n.id FROM protected_names p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.path LEFT JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=n.__path AND wrapper.id=n.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=coalesce(wrapper.parent,n.parent) WHERE (n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition') AND n.name_source=p.name AND parent.kind='module') OR (n.kind='assignment' AND n.left_source=p.name AND parent.kind='expression_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes m WHERE m.__path=parent.__path AND m.id=parent.parent AND m.kind='module')))

stages.name: runtime_hash
stages.query: SELECT "actual" FROM (SELECT sha256(group_concat(value,'|')) actual FROM (SELECT r.label||':'||r.name||':'||d.dump value FROM runtime_nodes r JOIN runtime_dumps d ON d.__path=r.__path AND d.id=r.id ORDER BY r.name))

stages.name: entry_keywords
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","name","entry" FROM (SELECT k.__path,k.value id,k.name,c.id entry FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND c.__start>=a.right_start AND c.__end<=a.right_end WHERE c.__path='l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' AND c.callee IN ('CachedPureLazyPolicyEntry','MemoizedPureLazyPolicyEntry') AND a.target_text IN ('_POLICY_ENTRIES','_MEMOIZED_POLICY_ENTRIES'))

stages.name: metadata_assignments
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","name" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.value id,a.target_text name FROM assignments a WHERE a.__path='l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' AND a.target_text IN ('ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE','ALLOWLIST_NAME','ALLOWLIST_VERSION','CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH','CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))

stages.name: literal_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT __path,id FROM entry_keywords UNION SELECT __path,id FROM metadata_assignments)

stages.name: metadata
stages.query: SELECT "name","value","literal_json" FROM (SELECT m.name,json_extract(v.literal_json,'$') value,v.literal_json FROM metadata_assignments m JOIN literal_values v ON v.__path=m.__path AND v.id=m.id)

stages.name: canonical_entries
stages.query: SELECT NULL AS "entry","value" FROM (SELECT entry,json_group_object(name,json(literal_json)) value FROM (SELECT k.entry,k.name,v.literal_json FROM entry_keywords k JOIN literal_values v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.id ORDER BY k.entry,k.name) GROUP BY entry)

stages.name: runtime_metadata
stages.query: SELECT "value" FROM (SELECT json_object('runtime_source_hash',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH'),'runtime_symbols',json((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))) value)

stages.name: signed_payload
stages.query: SELECT "message" FROM (SELECT json_object('allowlist',json_group_array(value),'linter',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_NAME'),'version',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_VERSION')) message FROM (SELECT value FROM (SELECT value FROM canonical_entries UNION ALL SELECT value FROM runtime_metadata) ORDER BY value))

stages.name: signature_valid
stages.query: SELECT "valid" FROM (SELECT verify_ed25519('7e9776d87292ab633115bd6c07892a4bf56450fffb2dfcf13b3eba1866b9fbb6',p.message,(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE')) valid FROM signed_payload p)

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "issue" FROM (SELECT 'cached pure-lazy runtime symbol metadata changed' issue WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES')))!=(SELECT count(*) FROM protected_names) OR EXISTS(SELECT name FROM protected_names EXCEPT SELECT value FROM json_each((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))) UNION ALL SELECT 'cached pure-lazy runtime source hash changed: actual='||h.actual||' policy='||m.value FROM runtime_hash h JOIN metadata m ON m.name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH' WHERE h.actual!=m.value UNION ALL SELECT 'cached pure-lazy policy signature is invalid' FROM signature_valid WHERE NOT valid)
